auth.label: API Token
auth.description: TrawlingWeb API token sent as the token query parameter. Sign in or create an account through the official FeedScale console at https://console.trawlingweb.app/login, then copy the token from your dashboard.

actions.name: search_news
actions.description: Search indexed news and blog publications through the TrawlingWeb News API.

query.description: A Lucene-compatible search expression, including optional field filters and Boolean operators.

countryPreference.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country preference required for safe Pay-per-Use billing.

fromTimestamp.description: The inclusive start timestamp in Unix milliseconds.

toTimestamp.description: The inclusive end timestamp in Unix milliseconds.

size.description: The maximum number of publications to return in this page.

sortBy.description: The publication timestamp used to sort results.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for searching TrawlingWeb news and blog publications.

id.description: The publication identifier assigned by TrawlingWeb.

published.description: The publication timestamp in ISO 8601 UTC format.

crawled.description: The crawl timestamp in Unix milliseconds.

domain.description: The domain where the publication was found.

site.description: The site where the publication was found.

site_type.description: The content type assigned to the source site.

site_section.description: The source site section containing the publication.

value.description: The estimated economic value of the publication.

url_image.description: The featured image URL when the add-on is enabled.

items.description: One indexed news or blog publication returned by TrawlingWeb.

data.description: The publications returned for this page.

requestLeft.description: The number of subscription requests remaining after this call.

totalResults.description: The total number of publications matching the query.

restResults.description: The number of matching publications not yet delivered.

fromTimestamp.description: The start timestamp for the next page.

toTimestamp.description: The end timestamp for the next page.

nextCursor.description: Safe timestamp cursor values parsed from the upstream next URL.

outputSchema.description: A normalized TrawlingWeb news search page without credential-bearing pagination URLs.
